image_mouse.jpg.ImageDescription: The first prototype computer mouse, developed by Bill English and famously used by Douglas Engelbart in "The Mother of All Demos", a demonstration of the oN-Line System in 1968.

image_xwindow.png.ImageDescription: This screenshot shows the X Window System running Tom's Window Manager (twm), and a number of client apps: the xlogo, an xterm, oclock, xbiff, xman, and xload.  This screenshot is reminiscent of a typical Unix graphical desktop from the late 1980s to early 1990s.
image_xwindow.png.SlideCredit: A desktop of the X Window System. Image: Liberal Classic, MIT licence, Wikimedia Commons.
image_xwindow.png.licence_note: Screenshot image; Commons names the licence as MIT.

image_qwerty.jpg.found_by: Wikimedia Commons, exact file title 'File:The Sholes & Glidden Typewriter of 1873.jpg'
image_qwerty.jpg.ImageDescription: The Sholes & Glidden typewriter of 1873, the first commercially successful typewriter.   It was called: The Type-Writer".  The Sholes & Glidden launched the global typewriter industry, an industry that prospered for more than a century.
image_qwerty.jpg.SlideCredit: The Sholes & Glidden typewriter of 1873. Photo: Tony Casillo, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons.
